hooks.command: cd ~/repos/llm-wiki && git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'log\.md' && ./scripts/publish-ai-kb.sh || true

input=$(cat); prompt=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('prompt',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$prompt" | grep -qi 'ingest' && echo "$prompt" | grep -qE '\.pdf'; then pdf=$(echo "$prompt" | grep -oE 'pdfs/[^ ]+\.pdf' | head -1); if [ -n "$pdf" ]; then mkdir -p /tmp/docling-wiki-out; full="$HOME/repos/llm-wiki/$pdf"; if [ -f "$full" ]; then if command -v docling >/dev/null 2>&1; then cd ~/repos/llm-wiki && docling "$full" --to md --output /tmp/docling-wiki-out/ 2>&1 && echo "[docling] Parsed to /tmp/docling-wiki-out/"; else echo "[docling] Not installed. Run: uv tool install docling"; fi; fi; fi; fi
